classification: Present since Flutter web support was introduced.
evidence: The initial web dispatcher used `setProxyURL` although the public API sent `setProxyURLString`, and treated the synchronous shared setter as a Promise. Both focused Chrome checks fail at this commit with its pinned 13.29.0 JavaScript bundle; both pass with the two-part fix. The parent had no web implementation.
limitations: Actual historical Dart handlers and pinned JS bundle; only the bundle URL was redirected to a local byte-identical download. No service/proxy connection or mobile execution.
